Messages.Author: Fabio "Sooner"
Messages.Body:



http://planeta.terra.com.br/lazer/vtesbrasil/kmw/spoilers.htm

It's in Portuguese, but obviously the card texts are in English, so
you can get a go.

The four links are, in order:

- the 58 vampires
- the 40 cards that require disciplines
- the 27 cards that require clan or sect (sect-based titles like
Cardinal are filed under this one)
- the 37 cards with no requirement (or non-sect based ones like
"requires Red List", "requires a titled non-Red List" or "require a
gun").

"Voltar a pagina de Spoilers" means "Back to spoiler index page".

Many thanks to The Lasombra and the ELDB update, where I got all cards
text!

best,
